_doc: BRANCH-SWEEP-1 policy. BRANCH-SWEEP-3: an idle port branch with no open pull request is moved to refs/archive/<name> and its head deleted, so only state, live, held and open-pull-request branches stay on the branch list. state_branches and state_prefixes are (parked/* is NOT state: parked work is merged or ported like any branch) written by the system itself (evidence ledgers) and are never merged or deleted by the sweep; the gate runs after every merge and a failure undoes that merge and files a PORT-BRANCH item.

carried._doc: BRANCH-SWEEP-4: a PORT-BRANCH item closes when main holds the code lines its branch added: at least min_share of them, with at most max_missing_lines absent. Files under residue_prefixes or ending in residue_suffixes are loop output, regenerated by their loops, and are not counted.

branch_cleanup.rule: BRANCH-CLEANUP-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): no branch outlives its pull request in any Ultrastable repository; delete_branch_on_merge is enforced on every fleet repo; AUTO-MERGE-DEFAULT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): allow_auto_merge is on in every repo too, and every tenant repo in doctrine/tenant-repos.json gets both settings as soon as it exists
